title: GTA Online
headline: GTA Online
subtitle: Apprehend the New Pegassi Ignus Pursuit Law Enforcement Vehicle
content:
Indulge in the wholesome joys of posing as Los Santos’ finest with the new Pegassi Ignus Pursuit Law Enforcement Vehicle in GTA Online. The Ignus Pursuit combines the LSPD’s penchant for high-speed carelessness with Pegassi’s aerodynamic, high-end stylings. Anyone attempting to flee the scene in a hot-wired jalopy doesn’t stand a chance.

Add the Pegassi Ignus Pursuit to your fleet — now available from Warstock Cache & Carry.
